inputs.question: ToG-R 是谁的变体，替换了哪种实体剪枝？在相同 N、D 下，论文给出的两种 LLM 调用公式相差多少？

outputs.expected_answer: ToG-R 是 ToG 的变体，以随机实体剪枝替代 LLM 实体剪枝。ToG 为 2ND+D+1，ToG-R 为 ND+D+1，相差 ND 次调用；这是公式差值，不是本项目测得的时延。

source_references.answer_point: ToG-R 用随机实体剪枝替代 LLM 实体剪枝；ToG 调用数 2ND+D+1，ToG-R 为 ND+D+1。
source_references.title: Think-on-Graph: Deep and Responsible Reasoning of Large Language Model with Knowledge Graph

source_evidence.title: Think-on-Graph: Deep and Responsible Reasoning of Large Language Model with Knowledge Graph
source_evidence.source_relative_path: Methods/215_Think-on-Graph Deep and Responsible Reasoning of Large Language Model with Knowledge Graph.pdf
source_evidence.text:
cand,n. Consequently, it needs N LLM calls for entity pruning and N
calls for relation pruning, respectively, as well as one additional LLM call for reasoning (evaluating if
the information from the current candidate paths are enough or not). We have to point it out that, for
each of the N starting entities, all its neighbor entities/relations are NOT scored one by one. On the
contrary, all its neighbor entities/relations are "translated" into "one" prompt altogether and are sent to
LLM, which output the top-N candidates at one-time. Therefore, each starting entity only calls LLM
once for pruning and so N starting entities calls LLM N times in one iterative step. Consequently,
there are totally 2ND + D times calling after reasoning D steps. In the end, there is an additional
calling that "translate" the final path to user-understandable language and answer the user. Therefore,
ToG requires 2ND + D + 1 LLM calls in total. Since most questions can be answered within 3 hops
(means depth of reasoning path is 3), and the performance is usually good enough when the search
width N=3 as we tested in Figure 3, the total number of LLM calling is 2 × 3 × 3 + 3 + 1 = 22. So
the computational time is about 21 times longer than that of LLM-only. With a similar performance
to ToG, its variant ToG-R only calls LLM for ND + D + 1 times by using random entity pruning
instead of LLM-based entity pruning, saving nearly half of computational time.

relation_review.evidence: 核对全部必要事实、引用与原文；没有来源时不得补造。
relation_review.semantics: 核对关系方向、实体角色、任务/实验条件和题干前提。
relation_review.uncertainty: 必要证据不足时明确说明缺口；反例允许纠正前提。

scoring_rules.primary: SupportRecall@5; within one fact unit supporting sources are OR, required fact units are AND.
scoring_rules.answer_review: Per-case atomic reference criteria, scored 0/1 each by a named reviewer; evidence support and citation location checked separately.
scoring_rules.graph_coverage: Source-backed expected subgraphs are a reference check, not measured retrieval success or answer correctness.
scoring_rules.denominator: 32 answerable questions; 24 cross-paper relation questions reported separately; 8 negative cases reported separately.
scoring_rules.interpretation: retrieval coverage, citation validity, graph-path coverage and semantic answer correctness are separate results; no assumption that graph wins.
scoring_rules.semantic_score: Number of supported satisfied atomic criteria / all criteria. This is not calculated by source ID recall.
scoring_rules.semantic_pass: All criteria satisfied with supporting citations; no critical unsupported claim. Negatives must correct/reject the premise within the evidence boundary.
critical_errors: 伪造继承/评测/全称优越性
混淆预算耗尽与正确答案
scoring_rules.reporting: Overview, per-category metrics, charts, latency, tokens and full paired details must coexist after real execution.
